item.title: Murderer of Sault woman sentenced May 14
item.description: The man who murdered a Sault Ste. Marie woman in her John Street apartment in September 2023 will be sentenced May 14. item.title: Sangestino wanted by Sault police
item.description: Rebecca Katherine Sangestino is wanted by police. Sangestino, 35, is wanted on five counts including assault and three counts fail to comply with probation order, a release says. Anyone with information about Sangestino can call Sault Ste. Marie Police Service at 705-949-6300 or Crime Stoppers at 705-942-7867or saultcrimestoppers.com.

item.title: Carter George, special teams get Soo Greyhounds back on track in Saginaw
item.description: “Elite goaltending and special teams bailed out a team that did not start on time," said head coach John Dean, whose Greyhounds halted a three-game skid.
